name: Pull Back the Frame
why_it_works: Polished content trains people to distrust polish. Opening on the perfect shot and then pulling back to reveal the clamps, tape, and crew behind it gives a jolt of surprise and makes the brand feel honest and self-aware.

hook.pattern: Start on the flawless final frame, then announce the pull-back.
examples: Perfect, right? Now look what's just out of frame.
What the camera usually cuts out at {{brand}}.

variables.name: crew_count
variables.description: How many people were behind it

variables.name: hidden_mess
variables.description: The funniest real mess just out of frame
variables.example: a stack of the seller's laundry on the dryer

variables.name: craft_detail
variables.description: One real technique used, written as a full sentence starting with a capital
variables.example: We waited 40 minutes for the sun to hit the windows

variables.name: offer
variables.description: Next step for the viewer, a full sentence starting with a capital, 7 words or fewer
variables.example: Book a listing consult this week

visual.prompt: The client's own finished {{shot_subject}} from {{brand}}, tight frame, exactly as published, vertical 9:16

beats.voiceover: Now look what's just out of frame.

visual.prompt: Real phone footage from the shoot: slow walk backward from the styled {{shot_subject}} revealing light stands, tape marks, the crew of {{crew_count}} and {{hidden_mess}}, vertical 9:16
Real phone photo of {{hidden_mess}} sitting just outside the set, flat practical light, vertical 9:16
Real photo of a {{brand}} crew member checking the camera monitor on set, back to camera, shared with consent, vertical 9:16

craft.notes: Everything here is the client's own footage, because a generated behind-the-scenes would be a fake. Frame the opening shot tight, then the real pull-back widens to show the mess. Keep the mess funny, never gross or private.

do_not: Reveal anything private about a client or their home without consent
Generate or stage the behind-the-scenes footage; it must be the real shoot
Imply listing photos misrepresent the property
compliance: Real estate: listing visuals must not misrepresent the property; never imply edits hide defects, and include brokerage name per your state's advertising rules
Med spa: do not show patients or treatment areas without written consent; no results claims in this format
Fair housing: no language or imagery that signals a preferred type of buyer or renter
